method: Unmodified original ClientSystem, MainLevel.update, TetheredCameraTracker and PlayerMarker in Chromium with bundled THREE. Actual MagicHexGrid. Explicit plain Object3D player health/arrival/presence/dolly state; UI updates, player removal and santaApp events stubbed. requestAnimationFrame disabled and performance clock held at 100ms to isolate living arrival/camera branches; NOT death timer/input/network/score/actor loading/init order or complete restart verification. MainLevel receives real source browser window.length=0; resize only changes explicit game dimensions. Marker geometry and material are actual constructor output; teardown tests marker detach, not concrete PlayerSystem removal.
